title: Short pn diode: Shockley I-V curve and linear minority-carrier profiles (analytic)
description:
An abrupt silicon p / n+ diode (N_A = 1e23 1/m^3 for x < 2 um, N_D = 1e24 beyond) on a 4 um strip two 2 nm cells high, SRH lifetime 1e-3 s (diffusion lengths ~1.9 / 1.1 mm: a short diode), no radiative recombination; ohmic contacts on the outer 10 nm, cathode at 0 V, anode forward-biased at V_a. Stationary sweep V_a = 0.35..0.65 V on one build (reuse_build: each bias continues from the previous converged state) (low injection, negligible series drop and depletion-region recombination; it starts at 0.35 V because the contact currents carry a float64 round-off floor of ~1e-12 A/m: each is the difference of the majority-carrier SG face terms, ~1e3 A/m at the n+ cathode (~40 A/m at the anode), so at 0.25 V (I ~2e-11 A/m) I_cathode was off -I_anode by 3 %, at 0.35 V by < 0.2 %).
Analytic (Shockley): I = (I_e0 + I_h0) (exp(V_a / V_T) - 1) per m of depth, I_e0 = q (n_i^2 / N_A) (D_n / L_n) coth(w_p / L_n) Ly, I_h0 = q (n_i^2 / N_D) (D_p / L_p) coth(w_n / L_p) Ly, D = mu V_T, L = sqrt(D tau); w_p, w_n = the neutral widths from the bias-dependent depletion edge (x_p = eps E_j / (q N_A), E_j with V_bi - V_a - 2 V_T) to the innermost held contact cell centre. The hole term is ~3 % of the total.
Derived values tab: I_anode (total), I_e_anode (electron = minority current leaving the anode side), I_h_cathode (minus the cathode hole current), I_cathode (= -I_anode) and ln_I = log(I_anode); expect ~0.1 % (up to ~1 %: the depletion edge is fuzzy by about a Debye length, 13 nm of the ~1.9 um neutral width).
Sweep tab: I_anode, I_e_anode, I_h_cathode versus V_a (compared per point: below the 3 % hole term), and ln_I with its straight dashed line of slope 1 / V_T (ideality 1; shown, not toleranced: the per-point I_anode error is its |d ln I|).
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 0.65 V): N_p_region = n_i^2 / N_A (1 + (exp(V_a / V_T) - 1) sinh((x - x_c) / L_n) / sinh(w_p / L_n)), linear from the anode contact to 6 Debye lengths before the depletion edge (closer in, the potential tail raises N by up to ~80 %), and P_n_region, its hole twin in the n region. Field tab: V, N, P and the quasi-Fermi potentials phi_n (flat at 0 across the junction) and phi_p (flat at V_a).

parameters.name: V_a
parameters.description: forward bias in V: anode (p side) voltage, cathode at 0 V (the sweep runs 0.35..0.65 V)

parameters.name: q_e
parameters.description: elementary charge in C

parameters.name: k_B
parameters.description: Boltzmann constant in J/K

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: V_T
parameters.description: thermal voltage in V (25.85 mV)

parameters.name: n_i
parameters.description: intrinsic carrier density in 1/m^3

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of silicon

parameters.name: eps_s
parameters.description: static permittivity in F/m

parameters.name: mu_e
parameters.description: electron mobility in m^2/(V s)

parameters.name: mu_h
parameters.description: hole mobility in m^2/(V s)

parameters.name: tau_life
parameters.description: SRH lifetime of both carriers in s (long: a short diode, negligible depletion-region recombination)

parameters.name: D_e
parameters.description: electron diffusion constant in m^2/s (Einstein relation)

parameters.name: D_h
parameters.description: hole diffusion constant in m^2/s

parameters.name: L_e
parameters.description: electron diffusion length in m (1.9 mm)

parameters.name: L_h
parameters.description: hole diffusion length in m (1.1 mm)

parameters.name: N_A
parameters.description: acceptor density of the p side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: N_D
parameters.description: donor density of the n side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (two cells per n-side Debye length)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: strip height (two cells: a 1D problem)

parameters.name: x_j
parameters.description: metallurgical junction (a cell face)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: width of each ohmic contact at the strip ends

parameters.name: x_anode_c
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held anode cell (minority density pinned to equilibrium there)

parameters.name: x_cathode_c
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held cathode cell

parameters.name: V_bi
parameters.description: built-in potential V_T (asinh(N_A / 2 n_i) + asinh(N_D / 2 n_i)) in V (0.893 V)

parameters.name: E_j
parameters.description: junction field magnitude in V/m (depletion approximation with the Debye-tail correction)

parameters.name: x_dep_p
parameters.description: depletion width on the p side in m

parameters.name: x_dep_n
parameters.description: depletion width on the n side in m

parameters.name: x_edge_p
parameters.description: p-side depletion edge in m

parameters.name: x_edge_n
parameters.description: n-side depletion edge in m

parameters.name: L_Debye_p
parameters.description: majority-carrier Debye length of the p side in m (13 nm)

parameters.name: L_Debye_n
parameters.description: majority-carrier Debye length of the n side in m (4.1 nm)

parameters.name: x_line_p_end
parameters.description: end of the N_p_region line: 6 Debye lengths before the edge, past the potential tail (~e^-6 of it left)

parameters.name: x_line_n_start
parameters.description: start of the P_n_region line: 6 Debye lengths beyond the n-side edge

parameters.name: w_p
parameters.description: neutral p width from the anode cell centre to the depletion edge in m

parameters.name: w_n
parameters.description: neutral n width from the depletion edge to the cathode cell centre in m

parameters.name: n_p0
parameters.description: equilibrium electron (minority) density of the p side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: p_n0
parameters.description: equilibrium hole (minority) density of the n side in 1/m^3

parameters.name: I_e0
parameters.description: electron saturation current in A per m of depth

parameters.name: I_h0
parameters.description: hole saturation current in A per m of depth

parameters.name: boost
parameters.description: Shockley factor exp(V_a / V_T) - 1

parameters.name: I_e_ref
parameters.description: analytic electron current in A/m

parameters.name: I_h_ref
parameters.description: analytic hole current in A/m

parameters.name: I_ref
parameters.description: analytic diode current in A/m
